_doc: Hand-authored verdicts for the 10 drawn canary sites (never regenerated by build.py). term_class: specific = a §3.1 term that is not _unspecified and not ancillary equipment; unspecified = a §3.1 _unspecified term; none = no §3.1 term used. witness: unit_heading / unit_equipment count under the registered rule (d0a43b46: emissions-unit heading or equipment description); unit_term and permit_description count only in the broadened reading. Quotes are in document order per document; check.py re-verifies each against the stored permit text (words in order) and binds it to its site through the printed Facility ID.

SITE-000814.note: Title V P0133722, issue 2023-09-01, effective 2023-09-22 to 2028-09-22. Holder Polynt Composites USA, Inc is the Atlas legal name ('Cook Composites & Polymers Co' is a trade name there). Unit headings are 'Process 1 - 20X Area' etc. with mixers; the facility-level description and a unit-level recordkeeping term say paint is manufactured.

quotes.quote: Title V renewal for a paint and coatings manufacturing facility
quotes.map_note: paint and coatings manufacturing = makes coatings; a facility summary, so it counts only in the broadened reading

quotes.quote: the company name of each paint batch manufactured
quotes.map_note: unit-level statement that paint batches are manufactured; not a heading or equipment description, so it counts only in the broadened reading

SITE-001530.note: Holder renamed between permits (TREMCO INC. - MAMECO DIVISION in 2021, TREMCO CPG INC. - MAMECO in 2023); the 2023 name equals the Atlas legal name once the division suffix is dropped. Face expiry 2026-09-13 is before 2026-11-18; no later permit listed.

quotes.quote: BLENDING AND STORAGE OF POLYURETHANE COATINGS
quotes.map_note: blending coatings in kettles, raw materials added, finished product pumped to pails = makes coatings

quotes.quote: FEPTIO renewal for blending vessels with powder dryers for the production of coatings and adhesives
quotes.map_note: 'production of coatings and adhesives'; adhesive_sealant_formulation is the only adhesive formulation term

SITE-000248.note: Three final permits (P0131913, P0131830, P0133197) together list K001-K005 with the same description. Scored like SITE-000601 and SITE-000997: words for applying a gel coat/resin by spray map to coating_applying. The shaping operation (spray-up open molding) still has no §3.1 term.

quotes.quote: K001 Polyester gelcoat and FRP (fiberglass reinforced plastic parts) spray up booth
quotes.map_note: gel coat sprayed onto FRP parts in a spray booth = applying a coating (same mapping as SITE-000601 coaters and SITE-000997 dip stations); spray-up open molding has no §3.1 term (vocabulary gap), composites_hand_layup would be inexact because the regulator lists Hand Lay-Up and spray-up as separate units at SITE-000238

quotes.quote: The emissions of organic material from the resin/gel coat spray gun operation consist of styrene and methyl methacrylate
quotes.map_note: resin/gel coat spray gun operation = spraying a resin/gel coating; corroborates the row above

SITE-000238.note: Face expiry of P0105759 is 2024-04-08, before 2026-11-18; no later permit listed. P0127661 (2019, chopper booth #3) is the newest document.

SITE-001833.note: P0137654 (2025-02-04, to 2030-02-04) and its administrative modification P0136498 (2025-03-28). Printed holder 'ACO, Inc' equals the ECHO facility name; the Atlas legal name is 'ACO Polymer Products, Inc.' with no trade name recorded, so the registered holder rule is not met.

quotes.quote: Polymer Concrete Extruder Line 1 (Automated Casting Line)
quotes.map_note: 'extruder' with no extrusion type = extrusion_unspecified; the line is called a casting line and makes polymer concrete, so what is extruded is not stated. Judgment-call; not a specific hit

SITE-000140.note: P0140000 effective 2026-06-10 to 2031-06-10 (a draft of the same permit precedes it). The Atlas site row has no street, so the registered bind is not met; the permit street equals the ECHO exporter street for the linked FRS record.

quotes.map_note: expanded polyethylene foam extrusion line = foam_extrusion

quotes.quote: FEPTIO renewal permit for the expanded polyethylene (EPE) foam extrusion line (P027)
quotes.map_note: same words in the permit description

SITE-000535.note: Title V P0134435 effective 2024-03-26 to 2029-03-26. The Atlas site row has no street, and the printed municipality is Saybrook Twp. (Atlas and ECHO: Ashtabula, same ZIP), so the registered bind is not met.

quotes.quote: Compression mold press #1 of thermoset, fiberglass reinforced composite plastic parts
The sheet mold compound (SMC) slitter and mold charge loading apparatus at each press (P001 - P008 and P020 - P023) is a computer-controlled system
quotes.map_note: re-adjudicated in round 2: the permit states SMC charges are loaded onto the molds at each named press, so the SMC subtype is supported in addition to compression_molding; unit term, so broadened reading only

quotes.quote: Continuous fiberglass laminating operation including, but not limited to: propeller mixer, saturating pans, squeeze rolls, electric ovens, conveyor, edge trim slitter and shear

SITE-000601.note: P0127863 (2020, face expiry 2025-04-01) lists the coaters and silkscreen units; P0140443 (2026-08-20, to 2031) covers the compounding group and refers to the controlled coating lines. Whether the coaters still run is not settled by either. Adjudicated in round 2: the 'Compounding' unit group stands as compounding_unspecified; pigment_colorant_dispersion is not used because the words say 'blending of pigments into raw compounds', not dispersion.

quotes.quote: K001 Reverse roll coater with optional in-line rotogravure station
quotes.map_note: reverse roll coater = coating line = coating_applying; silkscreen printing machines (K006, K009) are not mapped to printing_decorating_plastics because the substrate is not stated to be plastic

quotes.quote: Emissions Unit Group - Compounding: P002, P011, P012, and P014
5 mixers for the blending of pigments into raw compounds for subsequent coating and printing operations
quotes.map_note: pigment_colorant_dispersion considered and not used (blending, not dispersion, in the words)

quotes.quote: the amount of each HAP-containing material applied in the controlled coating lines
quotes.map_note: corroborates coating lines in the 2026 permit

SITE-000997.note: PTIO P0135320 effective 2024-07-15 to 2034-07-15. The units are epoxy dip stations coating metal parts; polymer relevance rests on the Atlas NAICS/ring, not on the permit. The extracted text has OCR noise elsewhere; the quoted words are clean.

quotes.quote: Epoxy dip station consisting of a vent hood over a dip pan and flash off rack, followed by an oven
quotes.map_note: epoxy dip station for coating = coating_applying

quotes.quote: Renewal PTIO for two miscellaneous metal parts coating lines at an electromagnetic coil manufacturing plant
